title: Basic Interval Drill
description: Schema-ready drill for recognizing and playing small intervals from C.
overview: An interval is the distance between two notes. This drill starts each interval on C.
goal: Hear and play the difference between a step, a third, and a fourth.
instructions: Play the first note, then the second note.
Listen to how each distance sounds larger than the last.
Use the highlighted key as your next target.
